body:
before reputation had a single review, 500 fans had heard every song — in her living rooms.

london, october 13. rhode island, the 18th and 19th. los angeles, the 22nd. nashville, the 25th. she picked the fans off social media herself and talked through each track before playing it. for an album rolled out with almost no press interviews, the secret sessions WERE the promotion.

not one song leaked.

a rhode island guest summed the whole thing up to abc news: "she just felt like my best friend."

the full story, with sources, lives on the reputation timeline: longlivets.com/?era=reputation

📷 the reputation stadium tour at metlife stadium, july 2018 — kevin mazur/tas18/getty images for tas
